plugins.name: music-composition
plugins.description: 51 skills in six layers: workflow and ARR-SPEC; general composition and arrangement craft; original style layers plus 21 Latin genre subskills (salsa, timba, bachata, merengue, reggaeton, dembow, cumbia, regional Mexican, corridos tumbados, Brazilian, tango, Latin jazz and more), a Latin fusion engine, execution and corpus. Includes artist innovation studies, historical lineage and contemporary crossovers. Plain text; output in the question language.
